text.ASV: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
text.BSB: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
text.KJV: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
text.CUVS: 起初， 神创造天地。
text.BUNGO: 元始に神天地を創造たまへり
text.LUT1912: Am Anfang schuf Gott Himmel und Erde.
text.LSG: Au commencement, Dieu créa les cieux et la terre.
text.RVR1909: EN el principio crió Dios los cielos y la tierra.
text.KRV: 태초에 하나님이 천지를 창조하시니라
text.BLIVRE: No princípio criou Deus os céus e a terra.
text.RIV1927: Nel principio Iddio creò i cieli e la terra.

text.ASV: And God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
text.BSB: So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
text.KJV: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
text.CUVS: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。
text.BUNGO: 神其像の如くに人を創造たまへり即ち神の像の如くに之を創造之を男と女に創造たまへり
text.LUT1912: Und Gott schuf den Menschen ihm zum Bilde, zum Bilde Gottes schuf er ihn; und schuf sie einen Mann und ein Weib.
text.LSG: Dieu créa l’homme à son image, il le créa à l’image de Dieu, il créa l’homme et la femme.
text.RVR1909: Y crió Dios al hombre á su imagen, á imagen de Dios lo crió; varón y hembra los crió.
text.KRV: 하나님이 자기 형상 곧 하나님의 형상대로 사람을 창조하시되 남자와 여자를 창조하시고
text.BLIVRE: E criou Deus o ser humano à sua imagem, à imagem de Deus o criou; macho e fêmea os criou.
text.RIV1927: E Dio creò l’uomo a sua immagine; lo creò a immagine di Dio; li creò maschio e femmina.

text.ASV: And God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
text.BSB: And God looked upon all that He had made, and indeed, it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning — the sixth day.
text.KJV: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
text.CUVS: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。有晚上，有早晨，是第六日。
text.BUNGO: 神其造りたる諸の物を視たまひけるに甚だ善りき夕あり朝ありき是六日なり
text.LUT1912: Und Gott sah alles an, was er gemacht hatte; und siehe da, es war sehr gut. Da ward aus Abend und Morgen der sechste Tag.
text.LSG: Dieu vit tout ce qu’il avait fait et voici, cela était très bon. Ainsi, il y eut un soir, et il y eut un matin: ce fut le sixième jour.
text.RVR1909: Y vió Dios todo lo que había hecho, y he aquí que era bueno en gran manera. Y fué la tarde y la mañana el día sexto.
text.KRV: 하나님이 그 지으신 모든 것을 보시니 보시기에 심히 좋았더라 저녁이 되며 아침이 되니 이는 여섯째 날이니라
text.BLIVRE: E viu Deus tudo o que havia feito, e eis que era bom em grande maneira. E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia sexto.
text.RIV1927: E Dio vide tutto quello che aveva fatto, ed ecco, era molto buono. Così fu sera, poi fu mattina: e fu il sesto giorno.

verses.theme: The first promise of a Savior

text.ASV: and I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed: he shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
text.BSB: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed. He will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.”
text.KJV: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
text.CUVS: 我又要叫你和女人彼此为仇； 你的后裔和女人的后裔也彼此为仇。 女人的后裔要伤你的头； 你要伤他的脚跟。
text.BUNGO: 又我汝と婦の間および汝の苗裔と婦の苗裔の間に怨恨を置ん彼は汝の頭を碎き汝は彼の踵を碎かん
text.LUT1912: Und ich will Feindschaft setzen zwischen dir und dem Weibe und zwischen deinem Samen und ihrem Samen. Derselbe soll dir den Kopf zertreten, und du wirst ihn in die Ferse stechen.
text.LSG: Je mettrai inimitié entre toi et la femme, entre ta postérité et sa postérité: celle-ci t’écrasera la tête, et tu lui blesseras le talon.
text.RVR1909: Y enemistad pondré entre ti y la mujer, y entre tu simiente y la simiente suya; ésta te herirá en la cabeza, y tú le herirás en el calcañar.
text.KRV: 내가 너로 여자와 원수가 되게 하고 너의 후손도 여자의 후손과 원수가 되게 하리니 여자의 후손은 네 머리를 상하게 할 것이요 너는 그의 발꿈치를 상하게 할 것이니라 하시고
text.BLIVRE: E porei inimizade entre ti e a mulher, e entre tua descendência e a descendência dela; esta te ferirá a cabeça, e tu lhe ferirás o calcanhar”.
text.RIV1927: E io porrò inimicizia fra te e la donna, e fra la tua progenie e la progenie di lei; questa progenie ti schiaccerà il capo, e tu le ferirai il calcagno”.

themes.pt-BR: A primeira promessa de um Salvador

text.ASV: and I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and be thou a blessing: and I will bless them that bless thee, and him that curseth thee will I curse: and in thee shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
text.BSB: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing. I will bless those who bless you and curse those who curse you; and all the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”
text.KJV: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
text.CUVS: 我必叫你成为大国。我必赐福给你，叫你的名为大；你也要叫别人得福。 为你祝福的，我必赐福与他；那咒诅你的，我必咒诅他。地上的万族都要因你得福。」
text.BUNGO: 我汝を大なる國民と成し汝を祝み汝の名を大ならしめん汝は祉福の基となるべし 我は汝を祝する者を祝し汝を詛ふ者を詛はん天下の諸の宗族汝によりて福禔を獲と
text.LUT1912: Und ich will dich zum großen Volk machen und will dich segnen und dir einen großen Namen machen, und sollst ein Segen sein. Ich will segnen, die dich segnen, und verfluchen, die dich verfluchen; und in dir sollen gesegnet werden alle Geschlechter auf Erden.
text.LSG: Je ferai de toi une grande nation, et je te bénirai; je rendrai ton nom grand, et tu seras une source de bénédiction. Je bénirai ceux qui te béniront, et je maudirai ceux qui te maudiront; et toutes les familles de la terre seront bénies en toi.
text.RVR1909: Y haré de ti una nación grande, y bendecirte he, y engrandeceré tu nombre, y serás bendición: Y bendeciré á los que te bendijeren, y á los que te maldijeren maldeciré: y serán benditas en ti todas las familias de la tierra.
text.KRV: 내가 너로 큰 민족을 이루고 네게 복을 주어 네 이름을 창대케 하리니 너는 복의 근원이 될지라 너를 축복하는 자에게는 내가 복을 내리고 너를 저주하는 자에게는 내가 저주하리니 땅의 모든 족속이 너를 인하여 복을 얻을 것이니라 하신지라
text.BLIVRE: E farei de ti uma grande nação, e te abençoarei, e engrandecerei o teu nome, e tu serás uma bênção. E abençoarei os que te abençoarem, e amaldiçoarei os que te amaldiçoarem; e em ti todas as famílias da terra serão benditas.”
text.RIV1927: e io farò di te una grande nazione e ti benedirò e renderò grande il tuo nome e tu sarai fonte di benedizione; e benedirò quelli che ti benediranno e maledirò chi ti maledirà e in te saranno benedette tutte le famiglie della terra”.

themes.ja: すべての国民への祝福
themes.fr: Une bénédiction pour toutes les nations
themes.it: Una benedizione per tutte le nazioni

text.ASV: And he believed in Jehovah; and he reckoned it to him for righteousness.
text.BSB: Abram believed the LORD, and it was credited to him as righteousness.
text.KJV: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
text.CUVS: 亚伯兰信耶和华，耶和华就以此为他的义。
text.BUNGO: アブラム、ヱホバを信ずヱホバこれを彼の義となしたまへり
text.LUT1912: Abram glaubte dem HERRN, und das rechnete er ihm zur Gerechtigkeit.
text.LSG: Abram eut confiance en l’Éternel, qui le lui imputa à justice.
text.RVR1909: Y creyó á Jehová, y contóselo por justicia.
text.KRV: 아브람이 여호와를 믿으니 여호와께서 이를 그의 의로 여기시고
text.BLIVRE: E creu ao SENHOR, e contou-lhe por justiça.
text.RIV1927: Ed egli credette all’Eterno, che gli contò questo come giustizia.

themes.ja: 信仰が義と認められる

verses.theme: Nothing too hard for the LORD

text.ASV: Is anything too hard for Jehovah? At the set time I will return unto thee, when the season cometh round, and Sarah shall have a son.
text.BSB: Is anything too difficult for the LORD? At the appointed time I will return to you — in about a year — and Sarah will have a son.”
text.KJV: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
text.CUVS: 耶和华岂有难成的事吗？到了日期，明年这时候，我必回到你这里，撒拉必生一个儿子。」
text.BUNGO: ヱホバに豈爲し難き事あらんや時至らば我定めたる期に爾に歸るべしサラに男子あらんと
text.LUT1912: Sollte dem HERRN etwas unmöglich sein? Um diese Zeit will ich wieder zu dir kommen über ein Jahr, so soll Sara einen Sohn haben.
text.LSG: Y a-t-il rien qui soit étonnant de la part de l’Éternel? Au temps fixé je reviendrai vers toi, à cette même époque; et Sara aura un fils.
text.RVR1909: ¿Hay para Dios alguna cosa difícil? Al tiempo señalado volveré á ti, según el tiempo de la vida, y Sara tendrá un hijo.
text.KRV: 여호와께 능치 못한 일이 있겠느냐 기한이 이를 때에 내가 네게로 돌아오리니 사라에게 아들이 있으리라
text.BLIVRE: Há para Deus alguma coisa difícil? Ao tempo assinalado voltarei a ti, segundo o tempo da vida, e Sara terá um filho.
text.RIV1927: V’ha egli cosa che sia troppo difficile per l’Eterno? Al tempo fissato, fra un anno, tornerò, e Sara avrà un figliuolo”.

themes.zh-Hans: 在耶和华岂有难成的事
themes.ja: 主に難しすぎることはない
themes.de: Dem HERRN ist nichts zu schwer
themes.fr: Rien n'est trop difficile pour l'Éternel
themes.pt-BR: Nada é difícil demais para o SENHOR
themes.it: Nulla è troppo difficile per l'Eterno

text.ASV: And Abraham said, God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt-offering, my son: so they went both of them together.
text.BSB: Abraham answered, “God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.” And the two walked on together.
text.KJV: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
text.CUVS: 亚伯拉罕说：「我儿， 神必自己预备作燔祭的羊羔。」于是二人同行。
text.BUNGO: アブラハム言けるは子よ神自ら燔祭の羔を備へたまはんと二人偕に進みゆきて
text.LUT1912: Abraham antwortete: Mein Sohn, Gott wird sich ersehen ein Schaf zum Brandopfer. Und gingen beide miteinander.
text.LSG: Abraham répondit: Mon fils, Dieu se pourvoira lui-même de l’agneau pour l’holocauste. Et ils marchèrent tous deux ensemble.
text.RVR1909: Y respondió Abraham: Dios se proveerá de cordero para el holocausto, hijo mío. E iban juntos.
text.KRV: 아브라함이 가로되 아들아 번제할 어린 양은 하나님이 자기를 위하여 친히 준비하시리라 하고 두 사람이 함께 나아가서
text.BLIVRE: E respondeu Abraão: Deus se proverá de cordeiro para o holocausto, filho meu. E iam juntos.
text.RIV1927: Abrahamo rispose: “Figliuol mio, Iddio se lo provvederà l’agnello per l’olocausto”. E camminarono ambedue assieme.

text.ASV: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee whithersoever thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
text.BSB: Look, I am with you, and I will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. For I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you.”
text.KJV: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
text.CUVS: 我也与你同在。你无论往哪里去，我必保佑你，领你归回这地，总不离弃你，直到我成全了向你所应许的。」
text.BUNGO: また我汝とともにありて凡て汝が往ところにて汝をまもり汝を此地に率返るべし我はわが汝にかたりし事を行ふまで汝をはなれざるなり
text.LUT1912: Und siehe, ich bin mit dir und will dich behüten, wo du hin ziehst, und will dich wieder herbringen in dies Land. Denn ich will dich nicht lassen, bis daß ich tue alles, was ich dir geredet habe.
text.LSG: Voici, je suis avec toi, je te garderai partout où tu iras, et je te ramènerai dans ce pays; car je ne t’abandonnerai point, que je n’aie exécuté ce que je te dis.
text.RVR1909: Y he aquí, yo soy contigo, y te guardaré por donde quiera que fueres, y te volveré á esta tierra; porque no te dejaré hasta tanto que haya hecho lo que te he dicho.
text.KRV: 내가 너와 함께 있어 네가 어디로 가든지 너를 지키며 너를 이끌어 이 땅으로 돌아오게 할지라 내가 네게 허락한 것을 다 이루기까지 너를 떠나지 아니하리라 하신지라
text.BLIVRE: E eis que eu estou contigo, e te guardarei por onde quer que fores, e te farei voltar a esta terra; porque não te deixarei, até que eu tenha feito o que te disse.”
text.RIV1927: Ed ecco, io son teco, e ti guarderò dovunque tu andrai, e ti ricondurrò in questo paese; poiché io non ti abbandonerò prima d’aver fatto quello che t’ho detto”.

themes.ja: わたしはあなたと共にいる

text.ASV: And as for you, ye meant evil against me; but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
text.BSB: As for you, what you intended against me for evil, God intended for good, in order to accomplish a day like this— to preserve the lives of many people.
text.KJV: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
text.CUVS: 从前你们的意思是要害我，但 神的意思原是好的，要保全许多人的性命，成就今日的光景。
text.BUNGO: 汝等は我を害せんとおもひたれども神はそれを善にかはらせ今日のごとく多の民の生命を救ふにいたらしめんとおもひたまへり
text.LUT1912: Ihr gedachtet's böse mit mir zu machen; aber Gott gedachte es gut zu machen, daß er täte, wie es jetzt am Tage ist, zu erhalten viel Volks.
text.LSG: Vous aviez médité de me faire du mal: Dieu l’a changé en bien, pour accomplir ce qui arrive aujourd’hui, pour sauver la vie à un peuple nombreux.
text.RVR1909: Vosotros pensasteis mal sobre mí, mas Dios lo encaminó á bien, para hacer lo que vemos hoy, para mantener en vida á mucho pueblo.
text.KRV: 당신들은 나를 해하려 하였으나 하나님은 그것을 선으로 바꾸사 오늘과 같이 만민의 생명을 구원하게 하시려 하셨나니
text.BLIVRE: Vós pensastes mal sobre mim, mas Deus o encaminhou para o bem, para fazer o que vemos hoje, para manter em vida muito povo.
text.RIV1927: Voi avevate pensato del male contro a me; ma Dio ha pensato di convertirlo in bene, per compiere quello che oggi avviene: per conservare in vita un popolo numeroso.

themes.ja: 神は良いことのために計られた

text.ASV: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
text.BSB: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
text.KJV: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
text.CUVS: 神对摩西说：「我是自有永有的」；又说：「你要对以色列人这样说：『那自有的打发我到你们这里来。』」
text.BUNGO: 神モーセにいひたまひけるは我は有て在る者なり又いひたまひけるは汝かくイスラエルの子孫にいふべし我有といふ者我を汝らに遣したまふと
text.LUT1912: Gott sprach zu Mose: ICH WERDE SEIN, DER ICH SEIN WERDE. Und sprach: Also sollst du den Kindern Israel sagen: ICH WERDE SEIN hat mich zu euch gesandt.
text.LSG: Dieu dit à Moïse: Je suis celui qui suis. Et il ajouta: C’est ainsi que tu répondras aux enfants d’Israël: Celui qui s’appelle “je suis” m’a envoyé vers vous.
text.RVR1909: Y respondió Dios á Moisés: YO SOY EL QUE SOY. Y dijo: Así dirás á los hijos de Israel: YO SOY me ha enviado á vosotros.
text.KRV: 하나님이 모세에게 이르시되 나는 스스로 있는 자니라 또 이르시되 너는 이스라엘 자손에게 이같이 이르기를 스스로 있는 자가 나를 너희에게 보내셨다 하라
text.BLIVRE: Deus respondeu a Moisés: EU SOU O QUE SOU. E disse: Assim dirás aos filhos de Israel: EU SOU me enviou a vós.
text.RIV1927: Iddio disse a Mosè: “Io sono quegli che sono”. Poi disse: “Dirai così ai figliuoli d’Israele: L’Io sono m’ha mandato da voi”.

themes.ja: 我は有りて在る者なり
themes.de: Ich werde sein, der ich sein werde

verses.theme: The LORD will fight for you

text.ASV: Jehovah will fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
text.BSB: The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still.”
text.KJV: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
text.CUVS: 耶和华必为你们争战；你们只管静默，不要作声。」
text.BUNGO: ヱホバ汝等のために戰ひたまはん汝等は靜りて居るべし
text.LUT1912: Der HERR wird für euch streiten, und ihr werdet still sein.
text.LSG: L’Éternel combattra pour vous; et vous, gardez le silence.
text.RVR1909: Jehová peleará por vosotros, y vosotros estaréis quedos.
text.KRV: 여호와께서 너희를 위하여 싸우시리니 너희는 가만히 있을지니라
text.BLIVRE: O SENHOR lutará por vós, e vós ficai quietos.
text.RIV1927: L’Eterno combatterà per voi, e voi ve ne starete queti”.

themes.de: Der HERR wird für euch streiten

text.ASV: Jehovah is my strength and song, And he is become my salvation: This is my God, and I will praise him; My father’s God, and I will exalt him.
text.BSB: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise Him, my father’s God, and I will exalt Him.
text.KJV: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
text.CUVS: 耶和华是我的力量，我的诗歌， 也成了我的拯救。 这是我的 神，我要赞美他， 是我父亲的 神，我要尊崇他。
text.BUNGO: わが力わが歌はヱホバなり彼はわが救拯となりたまへり彼はわが神なり我これを頌美ん彼はわが父の神なり我これを崇めん
text.LUT1912: Der HERR ist meine Stärke und mein Lobgesang und ist mein Heil. Das ist mein Gott, ich will ihn preisen; er ist meines Vaters Gott, ich will ihn erheben.
text.LSG: L’Éternel est ma force et le sujet de mes louanges; C’est lui qui m’a sauvé. Il est mon Dieu: je le célèbrerai; Il est le Dieu de mon père: je l’exalterai.
text.RVR1909: Jehová es mi fortaleza, y mi canción, y hame sido por salud: éste es mi Dios, y á éste engrandeceré; Dios de mi padre, y á éste ensalzaré.
text.KRV: 여호와는 나의 힘이요 노래시며 나의 구원이시로다 그는 나의 하나님이시니 내가 그를 찬송할 것이요 내 아비의 하나님이시니 내가 그를 높이리로다
text.BLIVRE: O SENHOR é minha força, e minha canção, E foi-me por salvação: Este é meu Deus, e a este engrandecerei; Deus de meu pai, e a este exaltarei.
text.RIV1927: L’Eterno è la mia forza e l’oggetto del mio cantico; egli è stato la mia salvezza. Questo è il mio Dio, io lo glorificherò; è l’Iddio di mio padre, io lo esalterò.

themes.it: La mia forza e il mio cantico

verses.theme: My presence will go with you

text.ASV: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
text.BSB: And the LORD answered, “My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
text.KJV: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
text.CUVS: 耶和华说：「我必亲自和你同去，使你得安息。」
text.BUNGO: ヱホバ言たまひけるは我親汝と共にゆくべし我汝をして安泰にならしめん
text.LUT1912: Er sprach: Mein Angesicht soll vorangehen; damit will ich dich leiten.
text.LSG: L’Éternel répondit: Je marcherai moi-même avec toi, et je te donnerai du repos.
text.RVR1909: Y él dijo: Mi rostro irá contigo, y te haré descansar.
text.KRV: 여호와께서 가라사대 내가 친히 가리라 내가 너로 편케 하리라
text.BLIVRE: E ele disse: Meu rosto irá contigo, e te farei descansar.
text.RIV1927: E l’Eterno rispose: “La mia presenza andrà teco, e io ti darò riposo”.

themes.ja: わたし自身が共に行く
themes.it: La mia presenza andrà con te

text.ASV: And Jehovah passed by before him, and proclaimed, Jehovah, Jehovah, a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness and truth;
text.BSB: Then the LORD passed in front of Moses and called out: “The LORD, the LORD God, is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness,
text.KJV: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
text.CUVS: 耶和华在他面前宣告说：「耶和华，耶和华，是有怜悯有恩典的 神，不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱和诚实，
text.BUNGO: ヱホバすなはち彼の前を過て宣たまはくヱホバ、ヱホバ憐憫あり恩惠あり怒ることの遅く恩惠と眞實の大なる神
text.LUT1912: Und der HERR ging vor seinem Angesicht vorüber und rief: HERR, HERR, GOTT, barmherzig und gnädig und geduldig und von großer Gnade und Treue!
text.LSG: Et l’Éternel passa devant lui, et s’écria: L’Éternel, l’Éternel, Dieu miséricordieux et compatissant, lent à la colère, riche en bonté et en fidélité,
text.RVR1909: Y pasando Jehová por delante de él, proclamó: Jehová, Jehová, fuerte, misericordioso, y piadoso; tardo para la ira, y grande en benignidad y verdad;
text.KRV: 여호와께서 그의 앞으로 지나시며 반포하시되 여호와로라 여호와로라 자비롭고 은혜롭고 노하기를 더디하고 인자와 진실이 많은 하나님이로라
text.BLIVRE: E passando o SENHOR por diante dele, proclamou: SENHOR, SENHOR, forte, misericordioso, e piedoso; tardio para a ira, e grande em benignidade e verdade;
text.RIV1927: E l’Eterno passò davanti a lui, e gridò: “L’Eterno! l’Eterno! l’Iddio misericordioso e pietoso, lento all’ira, ricco in benignità e fedeltà,

themes.ja: 憐れみ深く、恵みに富む

text.ASV: Thou shalt not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people; but thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself: I am Jehovah.
text.BSB: Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against any of your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.
text.KJV: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.
text.CUVS: 不可报仇，也不可埋怨你本国的子民，却要爱人如己。我是耶和华。
text.BUNGO: 汝仇をかへすべからず汝の民の子孫に對ひて怨を懐くべからず己のごとく汝の鄰を愛すべし我はヱホバなり
text.LUT1912: Du sollst nicht rachgierig sein noch Zorn halten gegen die Kinder deines Volks. Du sollst deinen Nächsten lieben wie dich selbst; denn ich bin der HERR.
text.LSG: Tu ne te vengeras point, et tu ne garderas point de rancune contre les enfants de ton peuple. Tu aimeras ton prochain comme toi-même. Je suis l’Éternel.
text.RVR1909: No te vengarás, ni guardarás rencor á los hijos de tu pueblo: mas amarás á tu prójimo como á ti mismo: Yo Jehová.
text.KRV: 원수를 갚지 말며 동포를 원망하지 말며 이웃 사랑하기를 네 몸과 같이 하라 나는 여호와니라
text.BLIVRE: Não te vingarás, nem guardarás rancor aos filhos de teu povo: mas amarás a teu próximo como a ti mesmo: Eu sou o SENHOR.
text.RIV1927: Non ti vendicherai, e non serberai rancore contro i figliuoli del tuo popolo, ma amerai il prossimo tuo come te stesso. Io sono l’Eterno. Osserverete le mie leggi.

text.ASV: Jehovah bless thee, and keep thee: Jehovah make his face to shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: Jehovah lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
text.BSB: ‘May the LORD bless you and keep you; may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you and be gracious to you; may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace.’
text.KJV: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
text.CUVS: 『愿耶和华赐福给你，保护你。 愿耶和华使他的脸光照你，赐恩给你。 愿耶和华向你仰脸，赐你平安。』
text.BUNGO: 願くはヱホバ汝を惠み汝を守りたまへ 願くはヱホバその面をもて汝を照し汝を憐みたまへ 願くはヱホバその面を擧て汝を眷み汝に平安を賜へと
text.LUT1912: Der HERR segne dich und behüte dich; der HERR lasse sein Angesicht leuchten über dir und sei dir gnädig; der HERR hebe sein Angesicht über dich und gebe dir Frieden.
text.LSG: Que l’Éternel te bénisse, et qu’il te garde! Que l’Éternel fasse luire sa face sur toi, et qu’il t’accorde sa grâce! Que l’Éternel tourne sa face vers toi, et qu’il te donne la paix!
text.RVR1909: Jehová te bendiga, y te guarde: Haga resplandecer Jehová su rostro sobre ti, y haya de ti misericordia: Jehová alce á ti su rostro, y ponga en ti paz.
text.KRV: 여호와는 네게 복을 주시고 너를 지키시기를 원하며 여호와는 그 얼굴로 네게 비취사 은혜 베푸시기를 원하며 여호와는 그 얼굴을 네게로 향하여 드사 평강주시기를 원하노라 할지니라 하라
text.BLIVRE: O SENHOR te abençoe, e te guarde: Faça resplandecer o SENHOR seu rosto sobre ti, e tenha de ti misericórdia: O SENHOR levante a ti seu rosto, e ponha em ti paz.
text.RIV1927: L’Eterno ti benedica e ti guardi! L’Eterno faccia risplendere il suo volto su te e ti sia propizio! L’Eterno volga verso te il suo volto, e ti dia la pace!

text.ASV: God is not a man, that he should lie, Neither the son of man, that he should repent: Hath he said, and will he not do it? Or hath he spoken, and will he not make it good?
text.BSB: God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind. Does He speak and not act? Does He promise and not fulfill?
text.KJV: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
text.CUVS: 神非人，必不致说谎， 也非人子，必不致后悔。 他说话岂不照着行呢？ 他发言岂不要成就呢？
text.BUNGO: 神は人のごとく謊ること无しまた人の子のごとく悔ること有ずその言ところは之を行はざらんやその語るところは之を成就ざらんや
text.LUT1912: Gott ist nicht ein Mensch, daß er lüge, noch ein Menschenkind, daß ihn etwas gereue. Sollte er etwas sagen und nicht tun? Sollte er etwas reden und nicht halten?
text.LSG: Dieu n’est point un homme pour mentir, Ni fils d’un homme pour se repentir. Ce qu’il a dit, ne le fera-t-il pas? Ce qu’il a déclaré, ne l’exécutera-t-il pas?
text.RVR1909: Dios no es hombre, para que mienta; ni hijo de hombre para que se arrepienta: el dijo, ¿y no hará?; habló, ¿y no lo ejecutará?
text.KRV: 하나님은 인생이 아니시니 식언치 않으시고 인자가 아니시니 후회가 없으시도다 어찌 그 말씀하신 바를 행치 않으시며 하신 말씀을 실행치 않으시랴
text.BLIVRE: Deus não é homem, para que minta; nem filho de homem para que se arrependa: ele disse, e não fará?; Falou, e não o executará?
text.RIV1927: Iddio non è un uomo, perch’ei mentisca, né un figliuol d’uomo, perch’ei si penta. Quand’ha detto una cosa non la farà? o quando ha parlato non manterrà la parola?

text.ASV: Hear, O Israel: Jehovah our God is one Jehovah: and thou shalt love Jehovah thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
text.BSB: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is One. And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
text.KJV: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
text.CUVS: 「以色列啊，你要听！耶和华—我们 神是独一的主。 你要尽心、尽性、尽力爱耶和华—你的 神。
text.BUNGO: イスラエルよ聽け我らの神ヱホバは惟一のヱホバなり 汝心を盡し精神を盡し力を盡して汝の神ヱホバを愛すべし
text.LUT1912: Höre, Israel, der HERR, unser Gott, ist ein einiger HERR. Und du sollst den HERRN, deinen Gott, liebhaben von ganzem Herzen, von ganzer Seele, von allem Vermögen.
text.LSG: Écoute, Israël! L’Éternel, notre Dieu, est le seul Éternel. Tu aimeras l’Éternel, ton Dieu, de tout ton cœur, de toute ton âme et de toute ta force.
text.RVR1909: Oye, Israel: Jehová nuestro Dios, Jehová uno es: Y amarás á Jehová tu Dios de todo tu corazón, y de toda tu alma, y con todo tu poder.
text.KRV: 이스라엘아 들으라 우리 하나님 여호와는 오직 하나인 여호와시니 너는 마음을 다하고 성품을 다하고 힘을 다하여 네 하나님 여호와를 사랑하라
text.BLIVRE: Ouve, Israel: o SENHOR nosso Deus, o SENHOR um é: E Amarás ao SENHOR teu Deus de todo teu coração, e de toda tua alma, e com todo tua poder.
text.RIV1927: Ascolta, Israele: l’Eterno, l’Iddio nostro, è l’unico Eterno. Tu amerai dunque l’Eterno, il tuo Dio, con tutto il cuore, con tutta l’anima tua e con tutte le tue forze.

text.ASV: Know therefore that Jehovah thy God, he is God, the faithful God, who keepeth covenant and lovingkindness with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations,
text.BSB: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God, the faithful God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion for a thousand generations of those who love Him and keep His commandments.
text.KJV: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
text.CUVS: 所以，你要知道耶和华—你的 神，他是 神，是信实的 神；向爱他、守他诫命的人守约，施慈爱，直到千代；
text.BUNGO: 汝知べし汝の神ヱホバは神にましまし眞實の神にましまして之を愛しその誡命を守る者には契約を保ち恩惠をほどこして千代にいたり
text.LUT1912: So sollst du nun wissen, daß der HERR, dein Gott, ein Gott ist, ein treuer Gott, der den Bund und die Barmherzigkeit hält denen, die ihn lieben und seine Gebote halten, in tausend Glieder,
text.LSG: Sache donc que c’est l’Éternel, ton Dieu, qui est Dieu. Ce Dieu fidèle garde son alliance et sa miséricorde jusqu’à la millième génération envers ceux qui l’aiment et qui observent ses commandements.
text.RVR1909: Conoce, pues, que Jehová tu Dios es Dios, Dios fiel, que guarda el pacto y la misericordia á los que le aman y guardan sus mandamientos, hasta las mil generaciones;
text.KRV: 그런즉 너는 알라 오직 네 하나님 여호와는 하나님이시요 신실하신 하나님이시라 그를 사랑하고 그 계명을 지키는 자에게는 천 대까지 그 언약을 이행하시며 인애를 베푸시되
text.BLIVRE: Conhece, pois, que o SENHOR teu Deus é Deus, Deus fiel, que guarda o pacto e a misericórdia aos que lhe amam e guardam seus mandamentos, até as mil gerações;
text.RIV1927: Riconosci dunque che l’Eterno, l’Iddio tuo, è Dio: l’Iddio fedele, che mantiene il suo patto e la sua benignità fino alla millesima generazione a quelli che l’amano e osservano i suoi comandamenti,

text.ASV: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by everything that proceedeth out of the mouth of Jehovah doth man live.
text.BSB: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that you might understand that man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.
text.KJV: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
text.CUVS: 他苦炼你，任你饥饿，将你和你列祖所不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，使你知道，人活着不是单靠食物，乃是靠耶和华口里所出的一切话。
text.BUNGO: 即ち汝を苦しめ汝を饑しめまた汝も知ず汝の先祖等も知ざるところのマナを汝らに食はせたまへり是人はパン而已にて生る者にあらず人はヱホバの口より出る言によりて生る者なりと汝に知しめんが爲なり
text.LUT1912: Er demütigte dich und ließ dich hungern und speiste dich mit Man, das du und deine Väter nie gekannt hattet; auf daß er dir kundtäte, daß der Mensch nicht lebt vom Brot allein, sondern von allem, was aus dem Mund des HERRN geht.
text.LSG: Il t’a humilié, il t’a fait souffrir de la faim, et il t’a nourri de la manne, que tu ne connaissais pas et que n’avaient pas connue tes pères, afin de t’apprendre que l’homme ne vit pas de pain seulement, mais que l’homme vit de tout ce qui sort de la bouche de l’Éternel.
text.RVR1909: Y te afligió, é hízote tener hambre, y te sustentó con maná, comida que no conocías tú, ni tus padres la habían conocido; para hacerte saber que el hombre no vivirá de solo pan, mas de todo lo que sale de la boca de Jehová vivirá el hombre.
text.KRV: 너를 낮추시며 너로 주리게 하시며 또 너도 알지 못하며 네 열조도 알지 못하던 만나를 네게 먹이신 것은 사람이 떡으로만 사는 것이 아니요 여호와의 입에서 나오는 모든 말씀으로 사는 줄을 너로 알게 하려 하심이니라
text.BLIVRE: E te afligiu, e te fez ter fome, e te sustentou com maná, comida que não conhecias tu, nem teus pais a conheciam; para fazer-te saber que o homem não viverá de só pão, mas de tudo o que sai da boca do SENHOR viverá o homem.
text.RIV1927: Egli dunque t’ha umiliato, t’ha fatto provar la fame, poi t’ha nutrito di manna che tu non conoscevi e che i tuoi padri non avean mai conosciuta, per insegnarti che l’uomo non vive soltanto di pane, ma vive di tutto quello che la bocca dell’Eterno avrà ordinato.

themes.ja: パンだけで生きるのではない

text.ASV: The secret things belong unto Jehovah our God; but the things that are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
text.BSB: The secret things belong to the LORD our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, so that we may follow all the words of this law.[’’]
text.KJV: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
text.CUVS: 「隐秘的事是属耶和华—我们 神的；惟有明显的事是永远属我们和我们子孙的，好叫我们遵行这律法上的一切话。」
text.BUNGO: 隠微たる事は我らの神ヱホバに屬する者なりまた顯露されたる事は我らと我らの子孫に屬し我らをしてこの律法の諸の言を行はしむる者なり
text.LUT1912: Das Geheimnis ist des HERRN, unsers Gottes; was aber offenbart ist, das ist unser und unserer Kinder ewiglich, daß wir tun sollen alle Worte dieses Gesetzes.
text.LSG: Les choses cachées sont à l’Éternel, notre Dieu; les choses révélées sont à nous et à nos enfants, à perpétuité, afin que nous mettions en pratique toutes les paroles de cette loi.
text.RVR1909: Las cosas secretas pertenecen á Jehová nuestro Dios: mas las reveladas son para nosotros y para nuestros hijos por siempre, para que cumplamos todas las palabras de esta ley.
text.KRV: 오묘한 일은 우리 하나님 여호와께 속하였거니와 나타난 일은 영구히 우리와 우리 자손에게 속하였나니 이는 우리로 이 율법의 모든 말씀을 행하게 하심이니라
text.BLIVRE: As coisas secretas pertencem ao SENHOR nosso Deus: mas as reveladas são para nós e para nossos filhos para sempre, para que cumpramos todas as palavras desta lei.
text.RIV1927: Le cose occulte appartengono all’Eterno, al nostro Dio, ma le cose rivelate sono per noi e per i nostri figliuoli, in perpetuo, perché mettiamo in pratica tutte le parole di questa legge.

text.ASV: Be strong and of good courage, fear not, nor be affrighted at them: for Jehovah thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
text.BSB: Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you; He will never leave you nor forsake you.”
text.KJV: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
text.CUVS: 你们当刚强壮胆，不要害怕，也不要畏惧他们，因为耶和华—你的 神和你同去。他必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。」
text.BUNGO: 汝ら心を強くしかつ勇め彼らを懼るる勿れ彼らの前に慄くなかれ其は汝の神ヱホバみづから汝とともに往きたまへばなり必ず汝を離れず汝を棄たまはじ
text.LUT1912: Seid getrost und unverzagt, fürchtet euch nicht und laßt euch nicht vor ihnen grauen; denn der HERR, dein Gott, wird selber mit dir wandeln und wird die Hand nicht abtun noch dich verlassen.
text.LSG: Fortifiez-vous et ayez du courage! Ne craignez point et ne soyez point effrayés devant eux; car l’Éternel, ton Dieu, marchera lui-même avec toi, il ne te délaissera point, il ne t’abandonnera point.
text.RVR1909: Esforzaos y cobrad ánimo; no temáis, ni tengáis miedo de ellos: que Jehová tu Dios es el que va contigo: no te dejará ni te desamparará.
text.KRV: 너는 마음을 강하게 하고 담대히 하라 그들을 두려워 말라 그들 앞에서 떨지 말라 이는 네 하나님 여호와 그가 너와 함께 행하실 것임이라 반드시 너를 떠나지 아니하시며 버리지 아니하시리라 하고
text.BLIVRE: Esforçai-vos e tende ânimo; não temais, nem tenhais medo deles: que o SENHOR teu Deus é o que vai contigo: não te deixará nem te desamparará.
text.RIV1927: Siate forti, fatevi animo, non temete e non vi spaventate di loro, perché l’Eterno, il tuo Dio, è quegli che cammina teco; egli non ti lascerà e non ti abbandonerà”.

text.ASV: And Jehovah, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
text.BSB: The LORD Himself goes before you; He will be with you. He will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.”
text.KJV: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
text.CUVS: 耶和华必在你前面行；他必与你同在，必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。」
text.BUNGO: ヱホバみづから汝に先だちて往きたまはんまた汝とともに居り汝を離れず汝を棄たまはじ懼るる勿れ驚くなかれ
text.LUT1912: Der HERR aber, der selber vor euch her geht, der wird mit dir sein und wird die Hand nicht abtun noch dich verlassen. Fürchte dich nicht und erschrick nicht.
text.LSG: L’Éternel marchera lui-même devant toi, il sera lui-même avec toi, il ne te délaissera point, il ne t’abandonnera point; ne crains point, et ne t’effraie point.
text.RVR1909: Y Jehová es el que va delante de ti; él será contigo, no te dejará, ni te desamparará; no temas, ni te intimides.
text.KRV: 여호와 그가 네 앞서 행하시며 너와 함께 하사 너를 떠나지 아니하시며 버리지 아니하시리니 너는 두려워 말라 놀라지 말라
text.BLIVRE: E o SENHOR é o que vai diante de ti; ele será contigo, não te deixará, nem te desamparará; não temas, nem te intimides.
text.RIV1927: E l’Eterno cammina egli stesso davanti a te; egli sarà con te; non ti lascerà e non ti abbandonerà; non temere e non ti perdere d’animo”.

themes.ja: あなたを見捨てられない

text.ASV: The eternal God is thy dwelling-place, And underneath are the everlasting arms. And he thrust out the enemy from before thee, And said, Destroy.
text.BSB: The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He drives out the enemy before you, giving the command, ‘Destroy him!’
text.KJV: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.
text.CUVS: 永生的 神是你的居所； 他永久的膀臂在你以下。 他在你前面撵出仇敌， 说：毁灭吧。
text.BUNGO: 永久に在す神は住所なり下には永遠の腕あり敵人を汝の前より驅はらひて言たまふ滅ぼせよと
text.LUT1912: Zuflucht ist bei dem alten Gott und unter den ewigen Armen. Und er wird vor dir her deinen Feind austreiben und sagen: Sei vertilgt!
text.LSG: Le Dieu d’éternité est un refuge, Et sous ses bras Éternels est une retraite. Devant toi il a chassé l’ennemi, Et il a dit: Extermine.
text.RVR1909: El eterno Dios es tu refugio, y acá abajo los brazos eternos; él echará de delante de ti al enemigo, y dirá: Destruye.
text.KRV: 영원하신 하나님이 너의 처소가 되시니 그 영원하신 팔이 네 아래 있도다 그가 네 앞에서 대적을 쫓으시며 멸하라 하시도다
text.BLIVRE: O eterno Deus é o teu refúgio, e abaixo os braços eternos; ele expulsará de diante de ti o inimigo, e dirá: Destrói.
text.RIV1927: l’Iddio che ab antico è il tuo rifugio; e sotto a te stanno le braccia eterne. Egli scaccia d’innanzi a te il nemico, e ti dice: “Distruggi!”

text.ASV: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth, but thou shalt meditate thereon day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
text.BSB: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do.
text.KJV: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
text.CUVS: 这律法书不可离开你的口，总要昼夜思想，好使你谨守遵行这书上所写的一切话。如此，你的道路就可以亨通，凡事顺利。
text.BUNGO: この律法の書を汝の口より離すべからず夜も晝もこれを念ひて其中に録したる所をことごとく守りて行へ然ば汝の途福利を得汝かならず勝利を得べし
text.LUT1912: Und laß dieses Buch des Gesetzes nicht von deinem Munde kommen, sondern betrachte es Tag und Nacht, auf daß du haltest und tust allerdinge nach dem, was darin geschrieben steht. Alsdann wird es dir gelingen in allem, was du tust, und wirst weise handeln können.
text.LSG: Que ce livre de la loi ne s’éloigne point de ta bouche; médite-le jour et nuit, pour agir fidèlement selon tout ce qui y est écrit; car c’est alors que tu auras du succès dans tes entreprises, c’est alors que tu réussiras.
text.RVR1909: El libro de aquesta ley nunca se apartará de tu boca: antes de día y de noche meditarás en él, para que guardes y hagas conforme á todo lo que en él está escrito: porque entonces harás prosperar tu camino, y todo te saldrá bien.
text.KRV: 이 율법책을 네 입에서 떠나지 말게 하며 주야로 그것을 묵상하여 그 가운데 기록한대로 다 지켜 행하라 그리하면 네 길이 평탄하게 될 것이라 네가 형통하리라
text.BLIVRE: O livro desta lei nunca se apartará de tua boca: antes de dia e de noite meditarás nele, para que guardes e faças conforme tudo o que nele está escrito: porque então farás prosperar teu caminho, e tudo te sairá bem.
text.RIV1927: Questo libro della legge non si diparta mai dalla tua bocca, ma meditalo giorno e notte, avendo cura di mettere in pratica tutto ciò che v’è scritto; poiché allora riuscirai in tutte le tue imprese, allora prospererai.

themes.es: Meditar de día y de noche

text.ASV: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of good courage; be not affrighted, neither be thou dismayed: for Jehovah thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
text.BSB: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
text.KJV: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
text.CUVS: 我岂没有吩咐你吗？你当刚强壮胆！不要惧怕，也不要惊惶；因为你无论往哪里去，耶和华—你的 神必与你同在。」
text.BUNGO: 我なんぢに命ぜしにあらずや心を強くしかつ勇め汝の凡て往く處にて汝の神ヱホバ偕に在せば懼るる勿れ戰慄なかれ
text.LUT1912: Siehe, ich habe dir geboten, daß du getrost und freudig seist. Laß dir nicht grauen und entsetze dich nicht; denn der HERR, dein Gott, ist mit dir in allem, was du tun wirst.
text.LSG: Ne t’ai-je pas donné cet ordre: Fortifie-toi et prends courage? Ne t’effraie point et ne t’épouvante point, car l’Éternel, ton Dieu, est avec toi dans tout ce que tu entreprendras.
text.RVR1909: Mira que te mando que te esfuerces y seas valiente: no temas ni desmayes, porque Jehová tu Dios será contigo en donde quiera que fueres.
text.KRV: 내가 네게 명한 것이 아니냐 마음을 강하게 하고 담대히 하라 두려워 말며 놀라지 말라 네가 어디로 가든지 네 하나님 여호와가 너와 함께 하느니라 하시니라
text.BLIVRE: Olha que te mando que te esforces e sejas valente: não temas nem desmaies, porque o SENHOR teu Deus será contigo onde quer que fores.
text.RIV1927: Non te l’ho io comandato? Sii forte e fatti animo; non ti spaventare e non ti sgomentare, perché l’Eterno, il tuo Dio, sarà teco dovunque andrai”.

verses.theme: As for me and my house

text.ASV: And if it seem evil unto you to serve Jehovah, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve Jehovah.
text.BSB: But if it is unpleasing in your sight to serve the LORD, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living. As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!”
text.KJV: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
text.CUVS: 若是你们以事奉耶和华为不好，今日就可以选择所要事奉的：是你们列祖在大河那边所事奉的神呢？是你们所住这地的亚摩利人的神呢？至于我和我家，我们必定事奉耶和华。」
text.BUNGO: 汝ら若ヱホバに事ふることを惡とせば汝らの先祖が河の彼邊にて事へし神々にもあれ又は汝らが今をる地のアモリ人の神々にもあれ汝らの事ふべき者を今日選べ但し我と我家とは共にヱホバに事へん
text.LUT1912: Gefällt es euch aber nicht, daß ihr dem HERRN dient, so erwählt euch heute, wem ihr dienen wollt: den Göttern, denen eure Väter gedient haben jenseit des Stroms, oder den Göttern der Amoriter, in deren Land ihr wohnt. Ich aber und mein Haus wollen dem HERRN dienen.
text.LSG: Et si vous ne trouvez pas bon de servir l’Éternel, choisissez aujourd’hui qui vous voulez servir, ou les dieux que servaient vos pères au-delà du fleuve, ou les dieux des Amoréens dans le pays desquels vous habitez. Moi et ma maison, nous servirons l’Éternel.
text.RVR1909: Y si mal os parece servir á Jehová, escogeos hoy á quién sirváis; si á los dioses á quienes sirvieron vuestros padres, cuando estuvieron de esotra parte del río, ó á los dioses de los Amorrheos en cuya tierra habitáis: que yo y mi casa serviremos á Jehová.
text.KRV: 만일 여호와를 섬기는 것이 너희에게 좋지 않게 보이거든 너희 열조가 강 저편에서 섬기던 신이든지 혹 너희의 거하는 땅 아모리 사람의 신이든지 너희 섬길 자를 오늘날 택하라 오직 나와 내 집은 여호와를 섬기겠노라
text.BLIVRE: E se mal vos parece servir ao SENHOR, escolhei hoje a quem sirvais; se aos deuses a os quais serviram vossos pais, quando estiveram da outra parte do rio, ou aos deuses dos amorreus em cuja terra habitais: que eu e minha casa serviremos ao SENHOR.
text.RIV1927: E se vi par mal fatto servire all’Eterno, scegliete oggi a chi volete servire: o agli dèi ai quali i vostri padri servirono di là dal fiume, o agli dèi degli Amorei, nel paese de’ quali abitate; quanto a me e alla casa mia, serviremo all’Eterno”.

themes.it: Quanto a me e alla casa mia

text.ASV: And Ruth said, Entreat me not to leave thee, and to return from following after thee, for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge; thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God;
text.BSB: But Ruth replied: “Do not urge me to leave you or to turn from following you. For wherever you go, I will go, and wherever you live, I will live; your people will be my people, and your God will be my God.
text.KJV: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:
text.CUVS: 路得说：「不要催我回去不跟随你。你往哪里去，我也往那里去；你在哪里住宿，我也在那里住宿；你的国就是我的国，你的 神就是我的 神。
text.BUNGO: ルツいひけるは汝を棄て汝をはなれて歸ることを我に催すなかれ我は汝のゆくところに往き汝の宿るところにやどらん 汝の民はわが民汝の神はわが神なり
text.LUT1912: Ruth antwortete: Rede mir nicht ein, daß ich dich verlassen sollte und von dir umkehren. Wo du hin gehst, da will ich auch hin gehen; wo du bleibst, da bleibe ich auch. Dein Volk ist mein Volk, und dein Gott ist mein Gott.
text.LSG: Ruth répondit: Ne me presse pas de te laisser, de retourner loin de toi! Où tu iras j’irai, où tu demeureras je demeurerai; ton peuple sera mon peuple, et ton Dieu sera mon Dieu;
text.RVR1909: Y Ruth respondió: No me ruegues que te deje, y me aparte de ti: porque donde quiera que tú fueres, iré yo; y donde quiera que vivieres, viviré. Tu pueblo será mi pueblo, y tu Dios mi Dios.
text.KRV: 룻이 가로되 나로 어머니를 떠나며 어머니를 따르지 말고 돌아가라 강권하지 마옵소서 어머니께서 가시는 곳에 나도 가고 어머니께서 유숙하시는 곳에서 나도 유숙하겠나이다 어머니의 백성이 나의 백성이 되고 어머니의 하나님이 나의 하나님이 되시리니
text.BLIVRE: E Rute respondeu: Não me rogues que te deixe, e que me aparte de ti: porque de onde quer que tu fores, irei eu; e de onde quer que viveres, viverei. Teu povo será meu povo, e teu Deus meu Deus.
text.RIV1927: Ma Ruth rispose: “Non insistere perch’io ti lasci, e me ne torni lungi da te; perché dove andrai tu, andrò anch’io; e dove starai tu, io pure starò; il tuo popolo sarà il mio popolo, e il tuo Dio sarà il mio Dio;

themes.ja: あなたの神はわたしの神
themes.it: Il tuo Dio, il mio Dio

text.ASV: There is none holy as Jehovah; For there is none besides thee, Neither is there any rock like our God.
text.BSB: There is no one holy like the LORD. Indeed, there is no one besides You! And there is no Rock like our God.
text.KJV: There is none holy as the LORD: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.
text.CUVS: 只有耶和华为圣； 除他以外没有可比的， 也没有磐石像我们的 神。
text.BUNGO: ヱホバのごとく聖き者はあらず其は汝の外に有る者なければなり又われらの神のごとき磐はあることなし
text.LUT1912: Es ist niemand heilig wie der HERR, außer dir ist keiner; und ist kein Hort, wie unser Gott ist.
text.LSG: Nul n’est saint comme l’Éternel; Il n’y a point d’autre Dieu que toi; Il n’y a point de rocher comme notre Dieu.
text.RVR1909: No hay santo como Jehová: porque no hay ninguno fuera de ti; y no hay refugio como el Dios nuestro.
text.KRV: 여호와와 같이 거룩하신 이가 없으시니 이는 주 밖에 다른 이가 없고 우리 하나님 같은 반석도 없으심이니이다
text.BLIVRE: Não há santo como o SENHOR: Porque não há ninguém além de ti; E não há refúgio como o nosso Deus.
text.RIV1927: Non v’è alcuno che sia santo come l’Eterno, poiché non v’è altro Dio fuori di te; ne v’è ròcca pari all’Iddio nostro.

themes.ja: 主のように聖なる方はいない

verses.theme: To obey is better than sacrifice

text.ASV: And Samuel said, Hath Jehovah as great delight in burnt-offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of Jehovah? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.
text.BSB: But Samuel declared: “Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obedience to His voice? Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and attentiveness is better than the fat of rams.
text.KJV: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.
text.CUVS: 撒母耳说： 耶和华喜悦燔祭和平安祭， 岂如喜悦人听从他的话呢？ 听命胜于献祭； 顺从胜于公羊的脂油。
text.BUNGO: サムエルいひけるはヱホバはその言にしたがふ事を善したまふごとく燔祭と犠牲を善したまふや夫れ順ふ事は犠牲にまさり聽く事は牡羔の脂にまさるなり
text.LUT1912: Samuel aber sprach: Meinst du, daß der HERR Lust habe am Opfer und Brandopfer gleich wie am Gehorsam gegen die Stimme des Herrn? Siehe, Gehorsam ist besser denn Opfer, und Aufmerken besser denn das Fett von Widdern;
text.LSG: Samuel dit: L’Éternel trouve-t-il du plaisir dans les holocaustes et les sacrifices, comme dans l’obéissance à la voix de l’Éternel? Voici, l’obéissance vaut mieux que les sacrifices, et l’observation de sa parole vaut mieux que la graisse des béliers.
text.RVR1909: Y Samuel dijo: ¿Tiene Jehová tanto contentamiento con los holocaustos y víctimas, como en obedecer á las palabras de Jehová? Ciertamente el obedecer es mejor que los sacrificios; y el prestar atención que el sebo de los carneros:
text.KRV: 사무엘이 가로되 여호와께서 번제와 다른 제사를 그 목소리 순종하는 것을 좋아하심 같이 좋아하시겠나이까 순종이 제사보다 낫고 듣는 것이 수양의 기름보다 나으니
text.BLIVRE: E Samuel disse: Tem o SENHOR tanto contentamento com os holocaustos e vítimas, como em obedecer às palavras do SENHOR? Certamente o obedecer é melhor que os sacrifícios; e o prestar atenção que a gordura dos carneiros:
text.RIV1927: E Samuele disse: “L’Eterno ha egli a grado gli olocausti e i sacrifizi come che si ubbidisca alla sua voce? Ecco, l’ubbidienza val meglio che il sacrifizio, e dare ascolto val meglio che il grasso dei montoni;

themes.ja: 従うことは犠牲にまさる
themes.fr: L'obéissance vaut mieux que les sacrifices
themes.es: Obedecer es mejor que los sacrificios

verses.theme: The LORD looks on the heart

text.ASV: But Jehovah said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have rejected him: for Jehovah seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but Jehovah looketh on the heart.
text.BSB: But the LORD said to Samuel, “Do not consider his appearance or height, for I have rejected him; the LORD does not see as man does. For man sees the outward appearance, but the LORD sees the heart.”
text.KJV: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.
text.CUVS: 耶和华却对撒母耳说：「不要看他的外貌和他身材高大，我不拣选他。因为，耶和华不像人看人：人是看外貌；耶和华是看内心。」
text.BUNGO: しかるにヱホバ、サムエルにいひたまひけるは其容貌と身長を觀るなかれ我すでにかれをすてたりわが視るところは人に異なり人は外の貌を見ヱホバは心をみるなり
text.LUT1912: Aber der HERR sprach zu Samuel: Sieh nicht an seine Gestalt noch seine große Person; ich habe ihn verworfen. Denn es geht nicht, wie ein Mensch sieht: ein Mensch sieht, was vor Augen ist; der HERR aber sieht das Herz an.
text.LSG: Et l’Éternel dit à Samuel: Ne prends point garde à son apparence et à la hauteur de sa taille, car je l’ai rejeté. L’Éternel ne considère pas ce que l’homme considère; l’homme regarde à ce qui frappe les yeux, mais l’Éternel regarde au cœur.
text.RVR1909: Y Jehová respondió á Samuel: No mires á su parecer, ni á lo grande de su estatura, porque yo lo desecho; porque Jehová mira no lo que el hombre mira; pues que el hombre mira lo que está delante de sus ojos, mas Jehová mira el corazón.
text.KRV: 여호와께서 사무엘에게 이르시되 그 용모와 신장을 보지 말라 내가 이미 그를 버렸노라 나의 보는 것은 사람과 같지 아니하니 사람은 외모를 보거니와 나 여호와는 중심을 보느니라
text.BLIVRE: E o SENHOR respondeu a Samuel: Não olhes à sua aparência, nem à sua grande estatura, porque eu o rejeito; porque o SENHOR olha não o que o homem olha; pois que o homem olha o que está diante de seus olhos, mas o SENHOR olha o coração.
text.RIV1927: Ma l’Eterno disse a Samuele: “Non badare al suo aspetto né all’altezza della sua statura, perché io l’ho scartato; giacché l’Eterno non guarda a quello a cui guarda l’uomo: l’uomo riguarda all’apparenza, ma l’Eterno riguarda al cuore”.

themes.de: Der HERR sieht das Herz an
themes.pt-BR: O SENHOR olha para o coração

text.ASV: As for God, his way is perfect: The word of Jehovah is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in him.
text.BSB: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
text.KJV: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
text.CUVS: 至于 神，他的道是完全的； 耶和华的话是炼净的。 凡投靠他的，他便作他们的盾牌。
text.BUNGO: 神は其道まつたしヱホバの言は純粋なし彼は都て己に倚賴む者の干となりたまふ
text.LUT1912: Gottes Wege sind vollkommen; des HERRN Reden sind durchläutert. Er ist ein Schild allen, die ihm vertrauen.
text.LSG: Les voies de Dieu sont parfaites, La parole de l’Éternel est éprouvée; Il est un bouclier pour tous ceux qui se confient en lui.
text.RVR1909: Dios, perfecto su camino: la palabra de Jehová purificada, escudo es de todos los que en él esperan.
text.KRV: 하나님의 도는 완전하고 여호와의 말씀은 정미하니 저는 자기에게 피하는 모든 자에게 방패시로다
text.BLIVRE: O caminho de Deus é perfeito; a palavra do SENHOR é purificada, é escudo é de todos os que nele confiam.
text.RIV1927: La via di Dio è perfetta, la parola dell’Eterno è purgata col fuoco. Egli è lo scudo di tutti quelli che sperano in lui.

text.ASV: and after the earthquake a fire; but Jehovah was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
text.BSB: After the earthquake there was a fire, but the LORD was not in the fire. And after the fire came a still, small voice.
text.KJV: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
text.CUVS: 地震后有火，耶和华也不在火中；火后有微小的声音。
text.BUNGO: 又地震の後に火ありしが火の中にはヱホバ在さざりき火の後に靜なる細微き聲ありき
text.LUT1912: Und nach dem Erdbeben kam ein Feuer; aber der HERR war nicht im Feuer. Und nach dem Feuer kam ein stilles, sanftes Sausen.
text.LSG: Et après le tremblement de terre, un feu: l’Éternel n’était pas dans le feu. Et après le feu, un murmure doux et léger.
text.RVR1909: Y tras el terremoto un fuego: mas Jehová no estaba en el fuego. Y tras el fuego un silbo apacible y delicado.
text.KRV: 또 지진 후에 불이 있으나 불 가운데도 여호와께서 계시지 아니하더니 불 후에 세미한 소리가 있는지라
text.BLIVRE: E depois do terremoto um fogo: mas o SENHOR não estava no fogo. E depois do fogo uma voz agradável e suave.
text.RIV1927: E, dopo il terremoto, un fuoco; ma l’Eterno non era nel fuoco. E, dopo il fuoco, un suono dolce e sommesso.

text.ASV: And he answered, Fear not; for they that are with us are more than they that are with them.
text.BSB: “Do not be afraid,” Elisha answered, “for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”
text.KJV: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.
text.CUVS: 神人说：「不要惧怕！与我们同在的比与他们同在的更多。」
text.BUNGO: エリシヤ答へけるは懼るなかれ我儕とともにある者は彼等とともにある者よりも多しと
text.LUT1912: Er sprach: Fürchte dich nicht! denn derer ist mehr, die bei uns sind, als derer, die bei ihnen sind.
text.LSG: Il répondit: Ne crains point, car ceux qui sont avec nous sont en plus grand nombre que ceux qui sont avec eux.
text.RVR1909: Y él le dijo: No hayas miedo: porque más son los que están con nosotros que los que están con ellos.
text.KRV: 대답하되 두려워하지 말라 우리와 함께한 자가 저와 함께한 자보다 많으니라 하고
text.BLIVRE: E ele lhe disse: Não tenhas medo: porque mais são os que estão conosco do que os que estão com eles.
text.RIV1927: Quegli rispose: “Non temere, perché quelli che son con noi son più numerosi di quelli che son con loro”.

themes.ja: 共にいる者の方が多い
themes.fr: Ils sont plus nombreux avec nous
themes.es: Más son los que están con nosotros
themes.pt-BR: Mais são os que estão conosco

text.ASV: Seek ye Jehovah and his strength; Seek his face evermore.
text.BSB: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
text.KJV: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.
text.CUVS: 要寻求耶和华与他的能力， 时常寻求他的面。
text.BUNGO: ヱホバとその能力とをたづねよ恒にその聖顔をたづねよ
text.LUT1912: Fraget nach dem HERRN und nach seiner Macht; suchet sein Angesicht allezeit!
text.LSG: Ayez recours à l’Éternel et à son appui, Cherchez continuellement sa face!
text.RVR1909: Buscad á Jehová y su fortaleza; buscad su rostro continuamente.
text.KRV: 여호와와 그 능력을 구할지어다 그 얼굴을 항상 구할지어다
text.BLIVRE: Procurai ao SENHOR e à sua força; buscai a sua face continuamente.
text.RIV1927: Cercate l’Eterno e la sua forza, cercate del continuo la sua faccia!

text.ASV: O give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
text.BSB: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
text.KJV: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.CUVS: 应当称谢耶和华； 因他本为善，他的慈爱永远长存！
text.BUNGO: ヱホバに感謝せよそのめぐみはふかくその憐憫はかぎりなし
text.LUT1912: Danket dem HERRN; denn er ist freundlich, und seine Güte währet ewiglich.
text.LSG: Louez l’Éternel, car il est bon, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
text.RVR1909: Celebrad á Jehová, porque es bueno; porque su misericordia es eterna.
text.KRV: 여호와께 감사하라 그는 선하시며 그 인자하심이 영원함이로다
text.BLIVRE: Celebrai a o SENHOR, porque é bom; Porque sua misericórdia é eterna.
text.RIV1927: Celebrate l’Eterno, perch’egli è buono, perché la sua benignità dura in perpetuo.

themes.ja: そのあわれみはとこしえに
themes.pt-BR: A sua misericórdia dura para sempre
themes.it: La sua benignità dura in eterno

text.ASV: Thine, O Jehovah, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heavens and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O Jehovah, and thou art exalted as head above all.
text.BSB: Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the splendor and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You. Yours, O LORD, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.
text.KJV: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.
text.CUVS: 耶和华啊，尊大、能力、荣耀、强胜、威严都是你的；凡天上地下的都是你的；国度也是你的，并且你为至高，为万有之首。
text.BUNGO: ヱホバよ權勢と能力と榮光と光輝と威光とは汝に屬す凡て天にある者地にある者はみな汝に屬すヱホバよ國もまた汝に屬す汝は萬有の首と崇られたまふ
text.LUT1912: Dir, HERR, gebührt die Majestät und Gewalt, Herrlichkeit, Sieg und Dank. Denn alles, was im Himmel und auf Erden ist. das ist dein. Dein, HERR, ist das Reich, und du bist erhöht über alles zum Obersten.
text.LSG: A toi, Éternel, la grandeur, la force et la magnificence, l’éternité et la gloire, car tout ce qui est au ciel et sur la terre t’appartient; à toi, Éternel, le règne, car tu t’élèves souverainement au-dessus de tout!
text.RVR1909: Tuya es, oh Jehová, la magnificencia, y el poder, y la gloria, la victoria, y el honor; porque todas las cosas que están en los cielos y en la tierra son tuyas. Tuyo, oh Jehová, es el reino, y la altura sobre todos los que están por cabeza.
text.KRV: 여호와여 광대하심과 권능과 영광과 이김과 위엄이 다 주께 속하였사오니 천지에 있는 것이 다 주의 것이로소이다 여호와여 주권도 주께 속하였사오니 주는 높으사 만유의 머리심이니이다
text.BLIVRE: Tua é, ó o SENHOR, a magnificência, e o poder, e a glória, a vitória, e a honra; porque todas as coisas que estão nos céus e na terra são tuas. Teu, ó o SENHOR, é o reino, e a altura sobre todos os que estão por cabeça.
text.RIV1927: A te, o Eterno, la grandezza, la potenza, la gloria, lo splendore, la maestà, poiché tutto quello che sta in cielo e sulla terra e tuo! A te, o Eterno, il regno; a te, che t’innalzi come sovrano al disopra di tutte le cose!

themes.ja: 偉大さはあなたのもの

text.ASV: if my people, who are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
text.BSB: and if My people who are called by My name humble themselves and pray and seek My face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, forgive their sin, and heal their land.
text.KJV: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
text.CUVS: 这称为我名下的子民，若是自卑、祷告，寻求我的面，转离他们的恶行，我必从天上垂听，赦免他们的罪，医治他们的地。
text.BUNGO: 我名をもて稱らるる我民もし自ら卑くし祈りてわが面を求めその惡き道を離れなば我天より聽てその罪を赦しその地を醫さん
text.LUT1912: und mein Volk sich demütigt, das nach meinem Namen genannt ist, daß sie beten und mein Angesicht suchen und sich von ihren bösen Wegen bekehren werden: so will ich vom Himmel hören und ihre Sünde vergeben und ihr Land heilen.
text.LSG: si mon peuple sur qui est invoqué mon nom s’humilie, prie, et cherche ma face, et s’il se détourne de ses mauvaises voies, je l’exaucerai des cieux, je lui pardonnerai son péché, et je guérirai son pays.
text.RVR1909: Si se humillare mi pueblo, sobre los cuales ni nombre es invocado, y oraren, y buscaren mi rostro, y se convirtieren de sus malos caminos; entonces yo oiré desde los cielos, y perdonaré sus pecados, y sanaré su tierra.
text.KRV: 내 이름으로 일컫는 내 백성이 그 악한 길에서 떠나 스스로 겸비하고 기도하여 내 얼굴을 구하면 내가 하늘에서 듣고 그 죄를 사하고 그 땅을 고칠지라
text.BLIVRE: Se se humilhar meu povo, sobre os quais nem nome é invocado, e orarem, e buscarem meu rosto, e se converterem de seus maus caminhos; então eu ouvirei desde os céus, e perdoarei seus pecados, e sararei sua terra.
text.RIV1927: se il mio popolo, sul quale è invocato il mio nome si umilia, prega, cerca la mia faccia e si converte dalle sue vie malvage, io lo esaudirò dal cielo, gli perdonerò i suoi peccati, e guarirò il suo paese.

themes.ja: わが民がへりくだるなら
themes.pt-BR: Se o meu povo se humilhar
themes.it: Se il mio popolo si umilia

text.ASV: For the eyes of Jehovah run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly; for from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
text.BSB: For the eyes of the LORD roam to and fro over all the earth, to show Himself strong on behalf of those whose hearts are fully devoted to Him. You have acted foolishly in this matter. From now on, therefore, you will be at war.”
text.KJV: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
text.CUVS: 耶和华的眼目遍察全地，要显大能帮助向他心存诚实的人。你这事行得愚昧；此后，你必有争战的事。」
text.BUNGO: ヱホバは全世界を徧く見そなはし己にむかひて心を全うする者のために力を顯したまふこの事において汝は愚なる事をなせり故に此後は汝に戰爭あるべしと
text.LUT1912: Denn des HERRN Augen schauen alle Lande, daß er stärke die, so von ganzem Herzen an ihm sind. Du hast töricht getan; darum wirst du auch von nun an Kriege haben.
text.LSG: Car l’Éternel étend ses regards sur toute la terre, pour soutenir ceux dont le cœur est tout entier à lui. Tu as agi en insensé dans cette affaire, car dès à présent tu auras des guerres.
text.RVR1909: Porque los ojos de Jehová contemplan toda la tierra, para corroborar á los que tienen corazón perfecto para con él. Locamente has hecho en esto; porque de aquí adelante habrá guerra contra ti.
text.KRV: 여호와의 눈은 온 땅을 두루 감찰하사 전심으로 자기에게 향하는 자를 위하여 능력을 베푸시나니 이 일은 왕이 망령되이 행하였은즉 이후부터는 왕에게 전쟁이 있으리이다 하매
text.BLIVRE: Porque os olhos do SENHOR contemplam toda a terra, para corroborar aos que têm coração íntegro com ele. Loucamente fizeste nisso; porque de agora em diante haverá guerra contra ti.
text.RIV1927: Poiché l’Eterno scorre collo sguardo tutta la terra per spiegar la sua forza a pro di quelli che hanno il cuore integro verso di lui. In questo tu hai agito da insensato; poiché, da ora innanzi, avrai delle guerre”.

text.ASV: and he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat: Thus saith Jehovah unto you, Fear not ye, neither be dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s.
text.BSB: And he said, “Listen, all you people of Judah and Jerusalem! Listen, King Jehoshaphat! This is what the LORD says: ‘Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army, for the battle does not belong to you, but to God.
text.KJV: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s.
text.CUVS: 他说：「犹大众人、耶路撒冷的居民，和约沙法王，你们请听。耶和华对你们如此说：『不要因这大军恐惧惊惶；因为胜败不在乎你们，乃在乎 神。
text.BUNGO: ヤハジエルすなはち言けるはユダの人衆およびヱルサレムの居民ならびにヨシヤパテ王よ聽べしヱホバかく汝らに言たまふ此大衆のために懼るる勿れ慄くなかれ汝らの戰に非ずヱホバの戰なればなり
text.LUT1912: und er sprach: Merkt auf, ganz Juda und ihr Einwohner zu Jerusalem und du, König Josaphat! So spricht der HERR zu euch: Ihr sollt euch nicht fürchten noch zagen vor diesem großen Haufen; denn ihr streitet nicht, sondern Gott.
text.LSG: Et Jachaziel dit: Soyez attentifs, tout Juda et habitants de Jérusalem, et toi, roi Josaphat! Ainsi vous parle l’Éternel: Ne craignez point et ne vous effrayez point devant cette multitude nombreuse, car ce ne sera pas vous qui combattrez, ce sera Dieu.
text.RVR1909: Y dijo: Oid, Judá todo, y vosotros moradores de Jerusalem, y tú, rey Josaphat. Jehová os dice así: No temáis ni os amedrentéis delante de esta tan grande multitud; porque no es vuestra la guerra, sino de Dios.
text.KRV: 야하시엘이 가로되 온 유다와 예루살렘 거민과 여호사밧 왕이여 들을지어다 여호와께서 너희에게 말씀하시기를 이 큰 무리로 인하여 두려워하거나 놀라지 말라 이 전쟁이 너희에게 속한 것이 아니요 하나님께 속한 것이니라
text.BLIVRE: E disse: Ouvi, Judá todo, e vós moradores de Jerusalém, e tu, rei Josafá. o SENHOR vos diz assim: Não temais nem vos amedronteis diante desta tão grande multidão; porque não é vossa a guerra, mas sim de Deus.
text.RIV1927: E Jahaziel disse: “Porgete orecchio, voi tutti di Giuda, e voi abitanti di Gerusalemme, e tu, o re Giosafat! Così vi dice l’Eterno: Non temete e non vi sgomentate a motivo di questa gran moltitudine; poiché questa non è battaglia vostra, ma di Dio.

text.ASV: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto him for whom nothing is prepared; for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye grieved; for the joy of Jehovah is your strength.
text.BSB: Then Nehemiah told them, “Go and eat what is rich, drink what is sweet, and send out portions to those who have nothing prepared, since today is holy to our Lord. Do not grieve, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”
text.KJV: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
text.CUVS: 又对他们说：「你们去吃肥美的，喝甘甜的，有不能预备的就分给他，因为今日是我们主的圣日。你们不要忧愁，因靠耶和华而得的喜乐是你们的力量。」
text.BUNGO: 而して彼らに言けるは汝ら去て肥たる者を食ひ甘き者を飮め而してその備をなし得ざる者に之を分ちおくれ此日は我らの主の聖日なり汝ら憂ふることをせざれヱホバを喜ぶ事は汝らの力なるぞかしと
text.LUT1912: Darum sprach er zu ihnen: Geht hin und eßt das Fette und trinkt das Süße und sendet denen auch Teile, die nichts für sich bereitet haben; denn dieser Tag ist heilig unserm HERRN. Und bekümmert euch nicht; denn die Freude am HERRN ist eure Stärke.
text.LSG: Ils leur dirent: Allez, mangez des viandes grasses et buvez des liqueurs douces, et envoyez des portions à ceux qui n’ont rien de préparé, car ce jour est consacré à notre Seigneur; ne vous affligez pas, car la joie de l’Éternel sera votre force.
text.RVR1909: Díjoles luego: Id, comed grosuras, y bebed vino dulce, y enviad porciones á los que no tienen prevenido; porque día santo es á nuestro Señor: y no os entristezcáis, porque el gozo de Jehová es vuestra fortaleza.
text.KRV: 느헤미야가 또 이르기를 너희는 가서 살찐 것을 먹고 단 것을 마시되 예비치 못한 자에게는 너희가 나누어 주라 이 날은 우리 주의 성일이니 근심하지 말라 여호와를 기뻐하는 것이 너희의 힘이니라 하고
text.BLIVRE: E disse-lhes mais: Ide, comei gorduras, e bebei doçuras, e enviai porções aos que não têm preparado; porque este é um dia consagrado ao nosso Senhor; portanto não vos entristeçais, porque a alegria do SENHOR é vossa força.
text.RIV1927: Poi Nehemia disse loro: “Andate, mangiate vivande grasse e bevete vini dolci, e mandate delle porzioni a quelli che nulla hanno di preparato per loro; perché questo giorno è consacrato al Signor nostro; non v’attristate; perché il gaudio dell’Eterno è la vostra forza”.

verses.theme: For such a time as this

text.ASV: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then will relief and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place, but thou and thy father’s house will perish: and who knoweth whether thou art not come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
text.BSB: For if you remain silent at this time, relief and deliverance for the Jews will arise from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. And who knows if perhaps you have come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”
text.KJV: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father’s house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
text.CUVS: 此时你若闭口不言，犹大人必从别处得解脱，蒙拯救；你和你父家必致灭亡。焉知你得了王后的位分不是为现今的机会吗？」
text.BUNGO: なんぢ若この時にあたりて默して言ずば他の處よりして助援と拯救ユダヤ人に興らんされど汝どなんぢの父の家は亡ぶべし 汝が后の位を得たるは此のごとき時のためなりしやも知るべからず
text.LUT1912: denn wo du wirst zu dieser Zeit schweigen, so wird eine Hilfe und Errettung von einem andern Ort her den Juden entstehen, und du und deines Vaters Haus werdet umkommen. Und wer weiß, ob du nicht um dieser Zeit willen zur königlichen Würde gekommen bist?
text.LSG: car, si tu te tais maintenant, le secours et la délivrance surgiront d’autre part pour les Juifs, et toi et la maison de ton père vous périrez. Et qui sait si ce n’est pas pour un temps comme celui-ci que tu es parvenue à la royauté?
text.RVR1909: Porque si absolutamente callares en este tiempo, respiro y libertación tendrán los Judíos de otra parte; mas tú y la casa de tu padre pereceréis. ¿Y quién sabe si para esta hora te han hecho llegar al reino?
text.KRV: 이 때에 네가 만일 잠잠하여 말이 없으면 유다인은 다른 데로 말미암아 놓임과 구원을 얻으려니와 너와 네 아비 집은 멸망하리라 네가 왕후의 위를 얻은 것이 이 때를 위함이 아닌지 누가 아느냐
text.BLIVRE: Porque se te calares agora, haverá alívio e libertação para os judeus de outra parte; porém tu e a casa de teu pai perecereis. E quem sabe se foi para tempo como este que chegaste a ser rainha?
text.RIV1927: Poiché se oggi tu taci, soccorso e liberazione sorgeranno per i Giudei da qualche altra parte; ma tu e la casa di tuo padre perirete; e chi sa se non sei pervenuta ad esser regina appunto per un tempo come questo?”

themes.ja: このような時のために

verses.theme: Blessed be the name of the LORD

text.ASV: and he said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: Jehovah gave, and Jehovah hath taken away; blessed be the name of Jehovah.
text.BSB: saying: “Naked I came from my mother’s womb, and naked I will return. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the name of the LORD.”
text.KJV: And said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.
text.CUVS: 说：「我赤身出于母胎，也必赤身归回；赏赐的是耶和华，收取的也是耶和华。耶和华的名是应当称颂的。」
text.BUNGO: 言ふ我裸にて母の胎を出たり 又裸にて彼處に歸らん ヱホバ與へヱホバ取たまふなり ヱホバの御名は讚べきかな
text.LUT1912: und sprach: Ich bin nackt von meiner Mutter Leibe gekommen, nackt werde ich wieder dahinfahren. Der HERR hat's gegeben, der HERR hat's genommen; der Name des HERRN sei gelobt.
text.LSG: et dit: Je suis sorti nu du sein de ma mère, et nu je retournerai dans le sein de la terre. L’Éternel a donné, et l’Éternel a ôté; que le nom de l’Éternel soit béni!
text.RVR1909: Y dijo: Desnudo salí del vientre de mi madre, y desnudo tornaré allá. Jehová dió, y Jehová quitó: sea el nombre de Jehová bendito.
text.KRV: 가로되 내가 모태에서 적신이 나왔사온즉 또한 적신이 그리로 돌아가올지라 주신 자도 여호와시요 취하신 자도 여호와시오니 여호와의 이름이 찬송을 받으실지니이다 하고
text.BLIVRE: E disse: Nu saí do ventre de minha mãe, e nu para lá voltarei. O SENHOR deu, e o SENHOR tomou; bendito seja o nome do SENHOR.
text.RIV1927: “Nudo sono uscito dal seno di mia madre, e nudo tornerò in seno della terra; l’Eterno ha dato, l’Eterno ha tolto; sia benedetto il nome dell’Eterno”.

themes.zh-Hans: 耶和华的名是应当称颂的
themes.ja: 主の御名はほむべきかな
themes.de: Der Name des HERRN sei gelobt
themes.fr: Que le nom de l'Éternel soit béni
themes.es: Bendito sea el nombre de Jehová
themes.pt-BR: Bendito seja o nome do SENHOR

text.ASV: But as for me I know that my Redeemer liveth, And at last he will stand up upon the earth:
text.BSB: But I know that my Redeemer lives, and in the end He will stand upon the earth.
text.KJV: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
text.CUVS: 我知道我的救赎主活着， 末了必站立在地上。
text.BUNGO: われ知る我を贖ふ者は活く 後の日に彼かならず地の上に立ん
text.LUT1912: Aber ich weiß, daß mein Erlöser lebt; und als der letzte wird er über dem Staube sich erheben.
text.LSG: Mais je sais que mon rédempteur est vivant, Et qu’il se lèvera le dernier sur la terre.
text.RVR1909: Yo sé que mi Redentor vive, y al fin se levantará sobre el polvo:
text.KRV: 내가 알기에는 나의 구속자가 살아 계시니 후일에 그가 땅 위에 서실 것이라
text.BLIVRE: Pois eu sei que meu Redentor vive, e ao fim se levantará sobre a terra;
text.RIV1927: Ma io so che il mio Vindice vive, e che alla fine si leverà sulla polvere.

themes.ja: わたしの贖い主は生きておられる

text.ASV: But he knoweth the way that I take; When he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
text.BSB: Yet He knows the way I have taken; when He has tested me, I will come forth as gold.
text.KJV: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
text.CUVS: 然而他知道我所行的路； 他试炼我之后，我必如精金。
text.BUNGO: わが平生の道は彼知たまふ 彼われを試みたまはば我は金のごとくして出きたらん
text.LUT1912: Er aber kennt meinen Weg wohl. Er versuche mich, so will ich erfunden werden wie das Gold.
text.LSG: Il sait néanmoins quelle voie j’ai suivie; Et, s’il m’éprouvait, je sortirais pur comme l’or.
text.RVR1909: Mas él conoció mi camino: probaráme, y saldré como oro.
text.KRV: 나의 가는 길을 오직 그가 아시나니 그가 나를 단련하신 후에는 내가 정금 같이 나오리라
text.BLIVRE: Porém ele conhece meu caminho: Provar-me-á, e sairei como ouro.
text.RIV1927: Ma la via ch’io batto ei la sa; se mi mettesse alla prova, ne uscirei come l’oro.

themes.ja: 金のように精錬される

text.ASV: I know that thou canst do all things, And that no purpose of thine can be restrained.
text.BSB: “I know that You can do all things and that no plan of Yours can be thwarted.
text.KJV: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
text.CUVS: 我知道，你万事都能做； 你的旨意不能拦阻。
text.BUNGO: 我知る汝は一切の事をなすを得たまふ また如何なる意志にても成あたはざる無し
text.LUT1912: Ich erkenne, daß du alles vermagst, und nichts, das du dir vorgenommen, ist dir zu schwer.
text.LSG: Je reconnais que tu peux tout, Et que rien ne s’oppose à tes pensées.
text.RVR1909: Yo conozco que todo lo puedes, y que no hay pensamiento que se esconda de ti.
text.KRV: 주께서는 무소불능하시오며 무슨 경영이든지 못 이루실 것이 없는 줄 아오니
text.BLIVRE: Eu sei que tudo podes, e nenhum de teus pensamentos pode ser impedido.
text.RIV1927: “Io riconosco che tu puoi tutto, e che nulla può impedirti d’eseguire un tuo disegno.

themes.ja: あなたには何でもできる

text.ASV: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the wicked, Nor standeth in the way of sinners, Nor sitteth in the seat of scoffers: But his delight is in the law of Jehovah; And on his law doth he meditate day and night.
text.BSB: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers. But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night.
text.KJV: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful. But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
text.CUVS: 不从恶人的计谋， 不站罪人的道路， 不坐亵慢人的座位， 惟喜爱耶和华的律法， 昼夜思想， 这人便为有福！
text.BUNGO: 惡きものの謀略にあゆまず つみびとの途にたたず 嘲るものの座にすわらぬ者はさいはひなり かかる人はヱホバの法をよろこびて日も夜もこれをおもふ
text.LUT1912: Wohl dem, der nicht wandelt im Rat der Gottlosen noch tritt auf den Weg Sünder noch sitzt, da die Spötter sitzen, sondern hat Lust zum Gesetz des HERRN und redet von seinem Gesetz Tag und Nacht!
text.LSG: Heureux l’homme qui ne marche pas selon le conseil des méchants, Qui ne s’arrête pas sur la voie des pécheurs, Et qui ne s’assied pas en compagnie des moqueurs, Mais qui trouve son plaisir dans la loi de l’Éternel, Et qui la médite jour et nuit!
text.RVR1909: BIENAVENTURADO el varón que no anduvo en consejo de malos, ni estuvo en camino de pecadores, ni en silla de escarnecedores se ha sentado; Antes en la ley de Jehová está su delicia, y en su ley medita de día y de noche.
text.KRV: 복 있는 사람은 악인의 꾀를 좇지 아니하며 죄인의 길에 서지 아니하며 오만한 자의 자리에 앉지 아니하고 오직 여호와의 율법을 즐거워하여 그 율법을 주야로 묵상하는 자로다
text.BLIVRE: Bem-aventurado o homem que não anda no conselho dos maus, nem fica parado no caminho dos pecadores, nem se senta junto dos escarnecedores. Mas sim, que tem seu prazer na Lei do SENHOR; e medita em sua Lei de dia e de noite.
text.RIV1927: Beato l’uomo che non cammina secondo il consiglio degli empi, che non si ferma nella via de’ peccatori, né si siede sul banco degli schernitori; ma il cui diletto è nella legge dell’Eterno, e su quella legge medita giorno e notte.

text.ASV: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; For thou, Jehovah, alone makest me dwell in safety.
text.BSB: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
text.KJV: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
text.CUVS: 我必安然躺下睡觉， 因为独有你—耶和华使我安然居住。
text.BUNGO: われ安然にして臥またねぶらん ヱホバよわれを獨にて坦然にをらしむるものは汝なり
text.LUT1912: Ich liege und schlafe ganz mit Frieden; denn allein du, HERR, hilfst mir, daß ich sicher wohne.
text.LSG: Je me couche et je m’endors en paix, Car toi seul, ô Éternel! tu me donnes la sécurité dans ma demeure.
text.RVR1909: En paz me acostaré, y asimismo dormiré; porque solo tú, Jehová, me harás estar confiado.
text.KRV: 내가 평안히 눕고 자기도 하리니 나를 안전히 거하게 하시는 이는 오직 여호와시니이다
text.BLIVRE: Eu deitarei, e dormirei em paz; porque só tu, SENHOR, me fazes descansar seguro.
text.RIV1927: In pace io mi coricherò e in pace dormirò, perché tu solo, o Eterno, mi fai abitare in sicurtà.

text.ASV: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, The moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained; What is man, that thou art mindful of him? And the son of man, that thou visitest him?
text.BSB: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place — what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
text.KJV: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained; What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
text.CUVS: 我观看你指头所造的天， 并你所陈设的月亮星宿， 便说：人算什么，你竟顾念他！ 世人算什么，你竟眷顾他！
text.BUNGO: 我なんぢの指のわざなる天を觀なんぢの設けたまへる月と星とをみるに 世人はいかなるものなればこれを聖念にとめたまふや 人の子はいかなるものなればこれを顧みたまふや
text.LUT1912: Wenn ich sehe die Himmel, deiner Finger Werk, den Mond und die Sterne, die du bereitet hast: was ist der Mensch, daß du seiner gedenkst, und des Menschenkind, daß du sich seiner annimmst?
text.LSG: Quand je contemple les cieux, ouvrage de tes mains, La lune et les étoiles que tu as créées: Qu’est-ce que l’homme, pour que tu te souviennes de lui? Et le fils de l’homme, pour que tu prennes garde à lui?
text.RVR1909: Cuando veo tus cielos, obra de tus dedos, la luna y las estrellas que tú formaste: Digo: ¿Qué es el hombre, para que tengas de él memoria, y el hijo del hombre, que lo visites?
text.KRV: 주의 손가락으로 만드신 주의 하늘과 주의 베풀어 두신 달과 별들을 내가 보오니 사람이 무엇이관대 주께서 저를 권고하시나이까
text.BLIVRE: Quando eu vejo teus céus, obra de teus dedos; a lua e as estrelas, que tu preparaste; O que é o homem, para que tu te lembres dele? E o que é o filho do homem, para que o visites?
text.RIV1927: Quand’io considero i tuoi cieli, opra delle tue dita, la luna e le stelle che tu hai disposte, che cos’è l’uomo che tu n’abbia memoria? e il figliuol dell’uomo che tu ne prenda cura?

text.ASV: I have set Jehovah always before me: Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
text.BSB: I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
text.KJV: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
text.CUVS: 我将耶和华常摆在我面前， 因他在我右边，我便不致摇动。
text.BUNGO: われ常にヱホバをわが前におけり ヱホバわが右にいませばわれ動かさるることなかるべし
text.LUT1912: Ich habe den HERRN allezeit vor Augen; denn er ist mir zur Rechten, so werde ich fest bleiben.
text.LSG: J’ai constamment l’Éternel sous mes yeux; Quand il est à ma droite, je ne chancelle pas.
text.RVR1909: A Jehová he puesto siempre delante de mí: porque está á mi diestra no seré conmovido.
text.KRV: 내가 여호와를 항상 내 앞에 모심이여 그가 내 우편에 계시므로 내가 요동치 아니하리로다
text.BLIVRE: Ponho ao SENHOR continuamente diante de mim; porque ele está à minha direita; nunca serei abalado.
text.RIV1927: Io ho sempre posto l’Eterno davanti agli occhi miei; poich’egli è alla mia destra, io non sarò punto smosso.

text.ASV: Thou wilt show me the path of life: In thy presence is fulness of joy; In thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
text.BSB: You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
text.KJV: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
text.CUVS: 你必将生命的道路指示我。 在你面前有满足的喜乐； 在你右手中有永远的福乐。
text.BUNGO: なんぢ生命の道をわれに示したまはん なんぢの前には充足るよろこびあり なんぢの右にはもろもろの快樂とこしへにあり
text.LUT1912: Du tust mir kund den Weg zum Leben; vor dir ist Freude die Fülle und liebliches Wesen zu deiner Rechten ewiglich.
text.LSG: Tu me feras connaître le sentier de la vie; Il y a d’abondantes joies devant ta face, Des délices éternelles à ta droite.
